miniProjects.title: Simon Game
miniProjects.shortDescription: Memory based game using JavaScript logic and pattern recognition.
miniProjects.details: A classic interactive Simon Says Game built using HTML, CSS and Vanilla JavaScript. The game generates a random sequence of colors that the player must remember and repeat correctly. Every successful level increases the difficulty. This project demonstrates DOM manipulation, event handling, game logic and animations.
